title: Globalization: local constancy on a connected open set gives T = c[[U]] (Steps 6–7 of Simon 2.34)
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n = m + 1, U ⊆ ℝⁿ open and connected and T ∈ D_n(U), and assume every x₀ ∈ U has r > 0 with B_r(x₀) ⊆ U and c ∈ ℝ such that T(ω) = c ∫ ω(x)(e_1,…,e_n) dLⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U) with spt ω ⊆ B_r(x₀). Then there is c ∈ ℝ with T(ω) = c ∫_U ω(x)(e_1,…,e_n) dLⁿ(x) for every ω ∈ Dⁿ(U).
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl (m + 1))), IsOpen U → IsConnected U → ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn U (m + 1), (∀ x₀ ∈ U, ∃ r : ℝ, 0 < r ∧ ball x₀ r ⊆ U ∧ ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) ⊆ ball x₀ r → T ω = c * ∫ x, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume) → ∃ c : ℝ, ∀ ω : TestFormOn U (m + 1), T ω = c * ∫ x in U, (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl (m + 1)) (m + 1)) x (fun i => EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) ∂volume
